content:
Track: Essential Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Python Fundamentals and Libraries for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 2: Handling and Loading CSV Data
    - Lesson 3: Manipulating Data with Pandas
    - Lesson 4: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) using Python
    - Lesson 6: Basic Statistics with NumPy and SciPy
    - Lesson 7: Data Visualization with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Seaborn for Advanced Plots

   Track: Intermediate Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Working with Databases using SQLite and Pandas
    - Lesson 2: Querying Large Datasets with Psycopg2 or sqlalchemy
    - Lesson 3: Time Series Analysis in Python
    - Lesson 4: Regression and Classification Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Machine Learning Basics with Scikit-Learn
    - Lesson 6: Model Evaluation, Selection, and Tuning
    - Lesson 7: Ensemble Methods for Improved Predictions
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Neural Networks (optional)

   Track: Data Cleaning & Preprocessing Techniques
    - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values in Datasets
    - Lesson 2: Data Normalization and Standardization
    - Lesson 3: Feature Engineering Strategies
    - Lesson 4: Outlier Detection and Handling
    - Lesson 5: Dimensionality Reduction Techniques (PCA, LDA)
    - Lesson 6: Text Preprocessing for Natural Language Processing
    - Lesson 7: Image Preprocessing for Computer Vision
    - Lesson 8: Real-world Case Studies on Data Cleaning and Preprocessing

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Advanced)
    - Lesson 1: Creating Custom Plots using Matplotlib
    - Lesson 2: Building Interactive Dashboards with Plotly or Bokeh
    - Lesson 3: Visualizing Time-Series Data with Date Ranges
    - Lesson 4: Map-based Visualization for Geographic Data
    - Lesson 5: Creating Heatmaps and Cluster Maps
    - Lesson 6: Comparative Analysis using Violin Plots or Boxplots
    - Lesson 7: Animation of Plots over Time or Iterations
    - Lesson 8: Integrating Data Visualization with Machine Learning Models

   Track: Database Management Systems (SQL)
    - Lesson 1: SQL Fundamentals and Query Syntax
    - Lesson 2: Advanced Queries: Subqueries, Joins, and Unions
    - Lesson 3: Creating and Managing Databases with SQL
    - Lesson 4: Optimizing SQL Queries for Efficiency
    - Lesson 5: Data Modeling: Normalization, Denormalization, and ERDs
    - Lesson 6: Transactions, ACID Properties, and Concurrency Control
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to PostgreSQL or MySQL
    - Lesson 8: Database Performance Tuning and Monitoring Techniques

   Track: Big Data & Cloud Computing for Analysts
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Big Data: Scalability and Storage Solutions
    - Lesson 2: Hadoop Ecosystem: MapReduce, HDFS, and HBase
    - Lesson 3: Spark for Fast Data Processing and ML
    - Lesson 4: AWS Redshift vs. Google BigQuery: Cloud-based Data Warehouses
    - Lesson 5: Using APIs to Access and Manage Big Data
    - Lesson 6: Real-time Data Streaming with Apache Kafka or Amazon Kinesis
    - Lesson 7: Scalable ETL Workflows for Data Integration
    - Lesson 8: Best Practices for Big Data Projects in the Cloud
